correction: The phrase 'Hartmann's published thesis §5' is bibliographically wrong. The University of Szeged repository labels the FULL dissertation 2008 and UNPUBLISHED: https://doktori.bibl.u-szeged.hu/id/eprint/1183/ . Its English thesis summary is dated 2007. Hartmann's separate Acta Sci. Math. 73 (2007), 71–89 is a published article, but its zbMATH review states results at regular-idempotent-band scope; it has not been established that the separate article contains the full §5 argument. Do not attribute the full §5 thesis result to that publication.
additional_written_finding: Every regular subsemigroup of any homomorphic image of a band-by-group semidirect product is orthodox: idempotents lift from the regular product, so the image's idempotents form a band, inherited by the regular subsemigroup. Therefore the source-dependent sufficiency described in the checkpoint, if accepted, is an iff for regular sources for the SN-band-by-group idempotent-separating-image target, not an iff for SN-band-by-CS targets.
